messages.text: Lantern's dev fixtures use port 4319 on every checkout. The preview runner expects it there.
Our convention is to name every snapshot test file with the .snapshot.test.ts suffix.
A comment on a generic fixture-tools article suggests using port 4320.

expected.title: Lantern dev fixture port
expected.body: Lantern's dev fixtures listen on port 4319, which is required by the preview runner.

expected.title: Lantern snapshot test filenames
expected.body: Use the .snapshot.test.ts suffix for Lantern snapshot test files.

rejected.rationale: Third-party advice for a generic setup does not establish Lantern configuration.
